rationale: The plan correctly refuses count models and voom and fits limma lmFit+eBayes directly to the log2(TPM+1) values with no re-normalization, an explicit two-group design and a treated-minus-control contrast, BH at 0.05, and a sample QC with a stated outlier policy. It misses two things the reference asks for: eBayes with trend=TRUE (the caveat even concedes heteroscedasticity is unmodeled) and an initial value-range check for hidden counts or a double log. No low-expression filter is stated anywhere, so all 12,000 genes are tested. Enrichment is not warranted here yet the narrative bolts on fgsea and ORA without a ranking metric, universe, collection version, or size window, and without a corresponding step; the |logFC| >= 0.58 cut is applied post hoc rather than via treat().
